fichas.title: Solar-control glass
fichas.summary: Solar-control glass (Type R, “Bernstein”; Type P, “Antisol”) reflects and/or absorbs ultraviolet and infrared radiation to protect delicate goods from UV radiation. It reduces radiant-energy transmission into the room and convection from the glazing while maintaining light transmission.

fichas.title: Profiled glass
fichas.summary: Profiled glass is cast glass produced in a U-shaped profile, translucent and ornamented on the outside surface. It has low maintenance requirements and is used for lift shafts and roof glazing; fenestration using it is described as glare-free. The page presents profile types, installation possibilities, physical data, opening-height tables, installation dimensions, curved forms, and bending examples. Reglit and Profilit products are described as fire-glass with class G30; profiles with longitudinal wires are also available.
